_comment: Copy this file to config/symphony.json and fill in your values.
_slackComment: Global Slack defaults. Deep-merged with board-, project-, and repo-level overrides. Skills like notify-review look up codeReviewChannel + reviewers from here.
_githubComment: Global GitHub defaults. The poller posts `github.codeReviewComment` on each new PR to trigger an external AI reviewer; deep-merged with board-, project-, and repo-level overrides. Leave the key absent to skip AI review entirely.
